# The Blue Card

> The Blue Card is a New York-based nonprofit (founded 1934) that provides financial assistance, emergency aid, health support and essential programs to Holocaust survivors in need in the United States. Official site: https://bluecard.org/ (formerly bluecardfund.org, which now redirects here).

## Key facts
- Legal name: The Blue Card, Inc. (EIN 13-1623910)
- Address: 171 Madison Avenue, Suite 1405, New York, NY 10016
- Phone: 212-239-2251
- Mission: help Holocaust survivors live with dignity through financial, medical and emergency assistance.
